execution.authorization: Preparation does not authorize execution. Root reviews REVIEW-FREEZE.json, freezes it as PRE-RUN-FREEZE.json with state ROOT_APPROVED_UNEXECUTED, and explicitly authorizes the separate OFF and ON commands.
execution.order: OFF must have complete historical parity plus terminal budget PASS before ON can launch.
execution.attempts: One exclusive run-off or run-on directory consumes the attempt even when preflight fails; no retry, directory replacement or extra model build.

perMode.RSSScope: macOS getrusage byte peaks, sum conservative, not simultaneous RSS and not an OS memory hard limit.

checks: Exact historical mesh stats and sampler count
Exact saved aggregate/ring statistics and top8
off.rawStream: New errors.f64le retained; authenticated reproduction only. The original historical stream was not retained.

on.sourceGrid: Decoded DEM minX/minZ/spacingKm/side; engine-identical CDM1 metadata
on.identity: Original positions and surface prefixes must match historical full-buffer hashes. Normals and indices may change; no old faceIndex identity claim.
on.topologyAccounting: All cell first/count ranges contiguous, original holes empty, counts <=20, sum covers all index entries; all vertex indices in range and all attributes finite. This is not a full manifold proof.
on.pairedComparison: Every ON error compared with its authenticated OFF Float64LE error, strict |on|<|off| improved / > worsened / equal; no epsilon. Sign flips, strict >5m crossings, compensated sums, RMS and top8 regressions/improvements reported globally, by material mask and original ring.
on.rawStream: ON errors.f64le retained too, same layout; future offline comparison needs no model rerun.
on.numericalFitGate: Within resources; global and landMask RMS strictly lower; global maxabs <= baseline+0.001m; landMask RMS rings2/3/4 strictly lower. No final <=5m or per-node monotonicity promise.
on.terminalVsDecision: run.json status PASS means complete validated execution within budget. selectionFitGatePASS separately records the predeclared numerical fit decision; neither is art/adoption approval.

measurement.order: increasing iz then ix, both inclusive
measurement.sign: positive means mesh is below the DEM reference

stream.encoding: Float64LE signed metres, one error per node, no header

measurement.top8Ties: earlier row-major order retained; exact extrema tie counts
measurement.masks: coastKm>=0 or <0 are material masks, not independent land truth
measurement.rings: Original grid ring membership unchanged; ring4 sampled only within the closed measured +/-48km square

limitsOfInference: ON uses the same source nodes for selection and assessment: fit, not holdout.
Float32 attributes with JavaScript Float64 interpolation/arithmetic; no GPU or WGSL parity.
No new rays, pixels, ROI, source-node search, adaptive measurement, old-module rebuild, GPU, browser, app/volume bake, tests, build or install.
Selection threshold is not a continuous, areal or final-node maximum-error bound.
Geometry cap excludes CPU lookup arrays, temporary allocation and Maps; RSS has a separate terminal gate.
No shadow-cause, photographic acceptance, presentation cadence or 60FPS claim.
